records.text: You shall appoint judges and recording officers for yourself in all your cities which the Lord your God gives you, according to your tribes; and they shall judge the people with righteous judgment.
They shall not pervert judgment, neither shall they show partiality, nor take a bribe; for bribes blind the eyes of the wise, and overthrow the words of the righteous.
You shall pursue justly that which is just, that you may live, and enter and inherit the land which the Lord your God gives you.
Seek the good and not the evil, so that you may live; then the Lord God Almighty will be with you, just as you said,
“We have hated evil things and loved good things.” Restore judgment at the gates, so that the Lord God Almighty may have mercy on Joseph’s remaining ones.
For the end. A psalm of David. A fool said in his heart, “There is no God.” They acted corruptly and became abominable in their practices; there is no one who shows kindness; there is not even one.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon the sons of men, to see whether there is anyone who understands or seeks God.

All turned aside; together they became useless; there is no one who shows kindness, not even one. Their throat is an open tomb; with their tongues they practiced deceit. The venom of asps is under their lips; their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness. Their feet are swift to shed blood; brokenness and misery are in their ways, and they did not know a way of peace. There is no fear of God before their eyes.
Will all those who practice lawlessness not know? Those who devour my people as a meal of bread did not call upon the Lord.
you will no longer continue. If you bring fine flour, it is futile. Incense is an abomination to Me. Your new moons and sabbaths and a great day I cannot endure; fasting and idleness,
and your new moons and your festivals My soul hates. You have become more than enough for Me; I will no longer let your sins go.
Whenever you stretch your hands toward Me, I will turn My eyes away from you. Even if you multiply supplication, I will not listen to you, for your hands are full of blood.
Wash yourselves, become clean. Remove the evils from your souls, before My eyes. Stop your evil deeds.
Learn to do good, seek judgment, rescue the wronged. Give judgment for the orphan and vindicate the widow.
And you, son of man, set your face firmly against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,

and say, ‘Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women sewing cushions upon every elbow of an arm and making coverings upon every head of every age, to distort lives! The lives of My people were distorted, and they were preserving lives.

They were profaning Me among My people for a handful of barley and scraps of bread, putting to death lives that ought not die and preserving lives that ought not live, as you uttered things to a people listening to vain pronouncements.

Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Behold, I am against your cushions, on which you entangle lives. I will tear them from your arms and send the lives out—their lives that you twist away—into dispersion.
I will tear your coverings and rescue My people from your hand. They will no longer be in your hands for entanglement, and you will recognize that I am the Lord.
Because you distorted the righteous person’s heart unjustly, though I was not distorting him, and strengthened the lawless person’s hands so that he does not turn at all from his evil way and live,
therefore you certainly will no longer see false things or divine divinations. I will rescue My people from your hand, and you will know that I am the Lord.’”
On that day, says the Lord, I will destroy the idols’ names from the land, and there will no longer be remembrance of them. I will remove the false prophets and the unclean spirit from the land.

If a person still prophesies, his father and mother who begot him will say to him, ‘You shall not live, because you spoke falsehoods in the Lord’s name.’ His father and mother who begot him will bind his feet when he prophesies.
On that day the prophets will be ashamed, each because of his vision when he prophesies; they will wear a hairy skin because they lied.
“Shout with strength and do not spare! Raise your voice like a trumpet and announce My people’s sins to them, and Jacob’s house their lawless acts.

Day after day they seek Me and desire to know My ways. Like a people who practiced righteousness and did not abandon their God’s judgment, they now ask Me righteous judgment and desire to draw near to God,
O you who acquire evil gain for your house, setting your nest on high to escape the hand of evils!
You planned shame for your house, brought many peoples to an end, and your soul sinned.
For a stone will cry from a wall, and a beetle from wood will utter these things.
Woe to the one building a city with bloodshed and preparing a city with injustices!
Are these things not from the Lord Almighty? Many peoples failed in fire, and many nations lost heart.
For the earth will be filled with knowing the Lord’s glory, as water will cover them.
But if you have trusted false words from which you will receive no benefit,
and murder and commit adultery and steal and swear unjustly, and you burned incense to Baal and followed foreign gods whom you do not know, to your own harm,
and you came and stood before Me in the house over which My name has been called and said, ‘We have kept away, so as not to do all these abominations,’
is My house, over which My name has been called there, a robbers’ cave before you? And behold, I have seen, says the Lord.
For go to My place in Shiloh, where I formerly made My name dwell, and see what I did to it because of the evil of My people Israel.
The word that came from the Lord to Isaiah son of Amos concerning Judea and Jerusalem.
In the last days the Lord’s mountain and God’s house will be clearly visible on the summits of the mountains and be raised above the hills; all the nations will come to it,

and many nations will go and say, “Come, let us go up to the Lord’s mountain and to the house of Jacob’s God. He will announce His way to us, and we will walk in it.” For law will go out from Zion, and the Lord’s word from Jerusalem.

He will judge between the nations and reprove a numerous people. They will beat their swords into plows and their spears into sickles. Nation will no longer take sword against nation, and they will certainly no longer learn to wage war.
Listen now, Joshua the high priest, you and your neighbors sitting before you, for they are men who watch for portents. Look, I am bringing My servant, Rising.
For the stone I set before Joshua—on the one stone are seven eyes. Look, I am digging a pit, says the Lord Almighty, and I will feel out all the injustice of that land in one day.
On that day, says the Lord Almighty, each of you will invite his neighbor beneath a vine and beneath a fig tree.”
Now fear the Lord and serve Him with uprightness and righteousness. Remove the foreign gods your fathers served beyond the River and in Egypt, and serve the Lord.

But if it does not please you to serve the Lord, choose for yourselves today whom you will serve: the gods of your fathers beyond the River, or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you dwell. But I and my house will serve the Lord, for He is holy.”
I will gather the crushed. Alas! Who took up reproach against her?
Look, I am acting within you for your sake at that time, says the Lord. I will save the oppressed and the rejected; I will receive them and make them a boast and renowned throughout the earth.

They will be ashamed at that time, when I do good to you and when I receive you. I will make you renowned and a boast among all the earth’s peoples, when I turn your captivity before you, says the Lord.
At the sound of a horseman and a drawn bow the whole countryside withdrew; they entered caves and hid in groves and climbed onto the rocks. Every city was abandoned; no human dwells in them.

And you, what will you do if you put on scarlet and adorn yourself with golden ornaments, and if you paint your eyes with antimony? Your adornment is in vain; your lovers have rejected you; they seek your soul.

For I heard a voice like a woman in labor, your groaning like one giving birth for the first time, the voice of the daughter of Zion. She will grow faint and let her hands fall: Woe to me, because my soul fails over those killed!
Leave Babylon, fleeing from the Chaldeans. Announce a voice of rejoicing, and let this be heard; proclaim it to the earth’s extremity. Say, “The Lord rescued His slave Jacob.”
Even if they thirst, He will lead them through a wilderness and bring water out of a rock for them. A rock will split and water will flow, and My people will drink.
From the day you stood opposed, on the day foreigners took his strength captive and strangers entered his gates and cast lots over Jerusalem, you too were like one of them.
Do not look on your brother’s day, on the day of strangers; do not rejoice over the sons of Judah on the day of their destruction; do not speak boastfully on the day of affliction.

Do not enter the gates of peoples on the day of their suffering. You, too, must not look on their assembly on the day of their destruction, and do not join in attacking their strength on the day of their destruction.
Do not stand at their escape routes to destroy those of them who are being saved, and do not shut in those fleeing from them on the day of affliction.
Proclaim these things among the nations: Consecrate war! Rouse the fighters! Draw near and come up, all soldiers!
Beat your plows into swords and your sickles into lances; let the powerless say, “I am strong!”
Assemble and enter, all surrounding nations, and gather there! Let the meek become a fighter!
Let all the nations be roused and come up to the Valley of Jehoshaphat, because there I will sit to judge all the surrounding nations.
Send out sickles, because the vintage is at hand! Enter and tread, because the winepress is full; the vats overflow, because their evils have multiplied.
Sounds rang out in the Valley of Judgment, because the Lord’s day is near in the Valley of Judgment.
Jacob, little Israel. I helped you,’ says God who redeems you, Israel.
Behold, I made you like new, saw-toothed wagon wheels for threshing. You will thresh mountains, grind hills fine, and make them like dust.
You will winnow, and wind will take them and a storm scatter them. But you will rejoice among Israel’s holy ones. And they will exult—
Dealing in anger, He cast me down and gnashed His teeth at me; the arrows of His raiders fell upon me.
He sprang upon me with points of eyes; He struck my jaw with a sharp point, and together they rushed down upon me.
For the Lord handed me into an unjust person’s hands and cast me upon the ungodly.
